clips.hook: He went back for the bag
clips.title: KreekCraft went back for the money bag in GTA 6… big mistake
clips.caption: Had the getaway bike. Went back for the bag anyway 💸
clips.voice_intro: Lucia just hit an armored truck, but in the chaos the money bag got left behind.
clips.voice_outro: Heist rule number one: the bag you drop is already gone. Riding off with what he had would have kept the cops far away.

clips.hook: Robbing a bank in leopard print
clips.title: KreekCraft refused to rob a bank in leopard print shorts in GTA 6
clips.caption: Tactical vest on top, leopard print on the bottom. Something had to change 🐆
clips.voice_intro: KreekCraft is gearing Lucia up for a bank job, then he finally notices the outfit.
clips.voice_outro: Body armor up top, leopard print down below. Changing pants was the right call, though that combo would have confused every guard inside.
